READY FOR AUDIT (operator 116) — growth-project-mobile#345 @ a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2

Piece S1 of the coach setup split of #329 (3 pieces: #345 -> #346 -> #347). Base `main`. T4 (max-tier rule).
Checks at this head (latest run per check, 4 checks): all green.
Land rule: Land as one (rule 11) after backend coach money #674-#677 + #675 is deployed; then #348-#351.

SIZE ASSESSMENT (operator 116, MODEL_ROUTING 8.2) — growth-project-mobile#345 @ a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2
- Lines: 1878 changed (source 1768 / tests 88 / migrations 0 / docs 22; excluded 0); 11 files. Under the 3,000 hard limit.
- Seams (largest areas): `src/lib/coachSetup` 865, `src/vendor/toqr` 547, `src/api/coachSetupApi.ts` 305, `src/components/coach` 143, `src/api/packagesApi.ts` 18.
- Coupling: code piece with its own tests; the piece boundaries, dependency direction (no piece imports a later piece) and per-piece tests are stated in the PR body.
- Decision: KEEP. This is already one logical piece of the owner-ordered split of #329. Cutting it further would separate code from the tests that prove it, and would add a restack round to every later piece without making any line easier to audit. Fix rounds must keep it under 3,000.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#345 @ a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/3/0

Independent T4 audit, AUD-SOL-S12-117, agent 117; the complete S1 diff, every new module, vendored encoder, existing adapters/call sites, backend contracts and original #329 AUDIT/FIX ROUND history were read, with **no inherited approval** because Sol's last original verdict was BLOCK. [Original Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/329#issuecomment-5972109610), [S1 size/land assessment](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/345#issuecomment-5975773820).

## Prior findings first

B-329-1's reported storage-refusal/read-failure/restart boundary remains closed: fresh creates require successful write-ahead persistence, unreadable storage is not absence, and unresolved keys no longer expire; the attributable failing-before execution and current actual-form controls were inspected. [Strict helper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2/src/lib/coachSetup/packageCreateIntent.ts#L124-L157), [failing-before execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37141312599), [current controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179741603).

**B-329-5 is NOT closed by the split**: the S1 helper is byte-identical to the original reviewed helper, and its missing live-origin predicate survives; B-345-1 below assigns that existing boundary to its owning slice rather than claiming a new regression. [Original finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/329#issuecomment-5972109610), [S1 helper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2/src/lib/coachSetup/packageCreateIntent.ts#L267-L336).

B-329-2/3/4 retain their scoped closures: truthful configuration copy, flat step bodies/legacy readers, and active-account requirements/action are present; A-329-1 remains an **operator-owned Money/composition prerequisite**, not a new A on this inert slice under merge-guide rule 9. [Error and wire implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2/src/api/coachSetupApi.ts#L239-L277), [active Connect requirements](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2/src/lib/coachSetup/connectCopy.ts#L122-L145), [composition ruling](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/329#issuecomment-5960908881).

## Must fix

### B-345-1 — inherited B-329-5: write-ahead admission starts a create after its originating form/session retires

`src/lib/coachSetup/packageCreateIntent.ts:267–280,289–303,324–334` accepts only a captured coach ID, not a live account/session/mount predicate; after `await saveIntent`, it invokes `onIntent` and dispatches create, and later create/update completions can invoke callbacks or follow-on updates without rechecking ownership. [Affected helper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2/src/lib/coachSetup/packageCreateIntent.ts#L267-L336).

**Counterexample:** hold actual-form write-ahead storage, unmount before any network create, then resolve storage: the actual S1 helper dispatches one create where zero was allowed; the new S2 actual-form probe reproduces this at a byte-identical S1 helper, independently of the original two owner/unmount failures. [Current executed assertion](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179741603/job/111369708813), [original owner/unmount proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37143533028).

**Minimal fix:** carry a live originating account/session generation plus mount/operation predicate into the helper; recheck after each awaited persistence/network boundary and before every subsequent create/update or memory callback, and keep the saved identity recoverable on cancellation rather than clearing it or starting another request. Verify held-write unmount and account-replacement tests fail before/pass after, and wire every actual caller in its owning slice.

### B-345-2 — changed-input replay falsely accepts a billing cadence the actual PATCH never sends

`src/lib/coachSetup/packageCreateIntent.ts:330–334` detects changed cadence, passes a full create input to update, then replaces the remembered input as though the change succeeded; however `src/api/packagesApi.ts:431–443,490–500` drops `billingInterval` and `intervalCount` from the actual PATCH, even though both the current backend and the required package-create backend accept their wire fields. [New helper update path](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2/src/lib/coachSetup/packageCreateIntent.ts#L330-L350), [actual mobile adapter](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2/src/api/packagesApi.ts#L431-L443), [backend update contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/a7b73e566c6ffc883743aa9c3a066120e0978291/src/packages/packages.controller.ts#L134-L160).

**Counterexamples:** replay a previously created monthly package after a lost response/publish failure, select one-time, then retry: the helper remembers one-time but actual PATCH contains no `billing_type`, leaving a recurring server offer; selecting free instead sends zero with the old recurring billing type and fails the backend's merged-pricing validation. Both independent assertions fail with the actual helper and actual mobile HTTP adapter, plus a contract-faithful pricing double for the free case; no live Stripe/database transaction is claimed. [Executed wire/pricing proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179742309/job/111369710659), [backend merged-pricing validation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/a5b605d1aa86f3afcece6061dc0502f20b83f27e/src/packages/packages.service.ts#L177-L240).

**Minimal fix:** align the PATCH mapper with supported `billing_type`, `billing_interval`, and `billing_interval_count`, including one-time clearing, and reconcile the actual returned configuration before remembering/reporting it as selected. Add monthly↔one-time, paid→free, cadence/count and lost-response replay regressions using the real adapter, not a mocked `update`.

### B-345-3 — unknown-error diagnostics violate the content/reference boundary

`src/lib/coachSetup/errors.ts:83–85,203–219` forwards the original untrusted exception to Sentry and obtains a reference only from a server response; a local/transport failure without one produces `requestId: null`, while arbitrary exception text is not removed by the current exception-value/URL scrub path. [New diagnostic call sites](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2/src/lib/coachSetup/errors.ts#L203-L219), [capture boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2/src/services/sentry.ts#L165-L179), [existing scrub policy](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2/src/services/sentryScrub.ts#L16-L39).

**Counterexamples:** an unknown local error returns no support reference, and a synthetic exception containing an email-like marker reaches `captureError` with that marker unchanged; both executable assertions fail, proving the call-site boundary rather than claiming live telemetry was sent. [Executed diagnostic assertions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179742309/job/111369710659).

**Minimal fix:** report a bounded content-free diagnostic (fixed error/category plus allowlisted codes/status) instead of raw exception text/config/body; use the existing correlation helpers to reuse or generate one diagnostic reference, tag that same reference in Sentry, and display its short form plus the support path. Verify email/message/body sentinels never reach the capture boundary and no-reference failures have the same attributable reference in UI/reporting.

## Verification and limits

All three required contexts are green at the candidate head; full CI executed 449 suites / 6,282 tests, which does not close these independent findings. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152922078/job/111290312174), [JS/TS analysis](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152922139/job/111290312064), [Actions analysis](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152922139/job/111290311953).

The S1 test-only lane at wrapper `fa06de5b91292ecafbf5584d6f63c871a557c856` differs from the candidate only by one new probe spec plus lane workflow/selector and executes **4 assertion failures / 6 passing controls**; the actual-form lane independently reproduces inherited B-329-5 at the unchanged helper blob. [S1 execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179742309), [actual-form execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179741603).

S1 adds no dependency/lockfile/migration or active route consumer; land remains rule-11 composition after backend prerequisites, with Money's A-329-1 closure and later wizard/editor assurance owned by their later slices/operator. [S1 candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2), [operator land rule](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/345#issuecomment-5975773820).

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#345 @ a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/2/3

Agent 117, job AUD-OPUS-S12-117 (Opus lens). Full independent audit of split piece W1 at its exact head (Opus never approved #329, so no evidence reuse). Base main; branch is behind main 7fdb629a, and the newer main commits touch only trust-center, Sentry and support files (no overlap). Required checks at this head: 4/4 green ([Typecheck, lint, test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152922078/job/111290312174), [Analyze js-ts](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152922139/job/111290312064), [Analyze actions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152922139/job/111290311953), [CodeQL](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/runs/111290408636)). Split fidelity: the #347 tree equals `git merge-tree --write-tree fc7fe73f 367e6c48`, so the stack top is the refreshed #329.

Probe: [CI lane run 37180178650](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37180178650) at this head plus one spec (`src/components/coach/setup/__tests__/audOpusS12HelperProbe.test.ts`, never merge): real `createPackageOnce` + real `coachPackagesApi.update` over a mocked axios instance. Result 3 failed / 1 passed (the control passes; every cadence case fails).

### B-345-1 — a cadence change after the package was made never reaches the server
- Where: `src/lib/coachSetup/packageCreateIntent.ts:331-334` (step "details changed after the package was made -> update it") calls `deps.update(packageId, input)` with the full create input; `src/api/packagesApi.ts:439-447` `toBackendUpdate` sends only `name`, `description`, `amount_cents`, `currency`, `is_active` and drops `billingInterval` / `intervalCount`. The comment at `packagesApi.ts:435-436` is stale: backend main `UpdatePackageDto` accepts `billing_type`, `billing_interval`, `billing_interval_count` (`src/packages/packages.dto.ts:115-128`).
- Counterexample (probe above): package made as $49 monthly, coach then picks One time: PATCH body is `{name, description, amount_cents: 4900, currency}` with no `billing_type`. Money consequence through the form (see #346 probe): the package is published as a monthly subscription while the app reports a one-time package. Paid to Free: PATCH `{amount_cents: 0}` on a recurring package, which backend main rejects with `PACKAGE_FREE_MUST_BE_ONE_TIME` (`packages.service.ts:870-874`) on every retry, so the coach cannot finish. One time to monthly: the recurring cadence is lost. The existing durability test cannot see this because its `update` mock discards the body (`packageCreateDurability.test.tsx:47,52` in #346).
- Fix rule: `toBackendUpdate` maps `billingInterval` / `intervalCount` exactly as the create body does (one_time -> `billing_type: one_time`; monthly -> `recurring` + `month` + count), and the stale TODO goes. Tests assert the exact PATCH body for monthly->one-time, one-time->monthly and paid->free. Closure: the probe spec passes at the new head, with a failing-before CI lane run. Side effect: this also fixes the package editor on main, where interval edits are silently dropped the same way (`CoachPackageEditScreen.tsx:183-184`, outside this diff).

### B-329-5 (Sol, retained; helper part) — the helper admits a create after the owner or mount has changed
- Where: `packageCreateIntent.ts:322-329`: `await saveIntent(...)` -> `onIntent(fresh)` -> `send(fresh)` with no liveness check. The same applies to the re-send at `:309-311` and to update/remember at `:331-334`. The helper is shared by the wizard form (#346) and the package editor (#347), and it gives callers no way to cancel between its own awaits.
- Counterexample: [CI lane run 37180389838](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37180389838) (#346 head): hold the write-ahead, then unmount the form, or switch the account, then release. Expected 0 creates, received 1 in both cases. Mitigations are noted and do not close it: `PersistedQueryCacheGate` unmounts navigators on identity change, and the request carries the token current at send time. Graded B because this is a T4 money-adjacent remote write at an account transition, the fleet rule says every await before a write re-checks identity, the fix is cheap, and FIX ROUND 5 claimed this was already closed.
- Fix rule: `createPackageOnce` takes an `isLive()` predicate (account and mount) and checks it after every await before `onIntent`, `send`, `update` and `remember`. When it returns false, stop without sending and leave the saved intent on disk so it resumes later. Closure: the two admission cases in the #346 probe pass.

### C-345-1 — the "never a second package" guarantee does not survive sign-out
`packageCreateIntent.ts:2-3,16-18` promises that no retry can ever make a second package, and the form says "It will not be made twice". But sign-out runs `clearAllStorage()` (`authActions.ts:379`, `mmkv.ts:248-254`), which deletes `coachSetup.packageCreate.v1:<coach>`. So the sequence "create sent, answer lost, sign out, sign in, Create" goes out under a fresh key and leaves an extra draft. Fix rule: narrow the header claim and the resumed copy to what holds (the same account on this device), or keep the coach-scoped intent through sign-out only if that fits the R15 shared-device wipe rule. Test either way.

### C-345-2 — W1 code is tested only in W3
Tests for `stepBlob` / `saveStep` (B-329-3), `CONNECT_NOT_CONFIGURED` copy (B-329-2), `loadSetupStatus` (C-329-2/4) and `qrPath` exist only in #347 (`coachSetup.test.tsx`, `coachSetupRound2.test.tsx`). W1 alone carries only `connectCopyStates.test.ts`. This is acceptable only because the stack lands as one (rule 11).

### C-345-3 — PR body has no structured tier header
T4 is stated in prose and in the READY comment, not as the Tier / Why / T4 trigger scan header (C-329-5 was closed for #329's body only).

### #329 findings in the split (W1 scope)
Closed in code: B-329-2 (`errors.ts:113`), B-329-3 (`coachSetupApi.ts:239-278`, flat step body + `stepBlob`), B-329-4 (`connectCopy.ts:122`, active with due items), C-329-1 (`isLivePackage`, `packagesApi.ts:449-460`), C-329-2 (`setupStatus.ts:89-106`, server client signal), C-329-8 (`packageCreateIntent.ts:313-319`, 410 makes a fresh create in the same tap). B-329-1 is closed for its scope (strict write-ahead `:322-326`, unreadable is not "none"); the residuals are B-329-5 and C-345-1 above. C-329-6 was closed by backend #675 (merged). C-329-3 and the wizard parts live in #347. A-329-1 (Money page) belongs to #348-#351 and does not block this piece (rule 9); nothing in W1 routes to Earnings. Still open: B-329-5.

Head re-read immediately before posting: a4e4958820053b5aaa0f2d4a8c14f140816541b2.

FIX ROUND 1 (B-WIZ-118, agent 118) — growth-project-mobile#345 @ 97c9005e644ebc13731d1477bfecc270a10552fd

Brought up to main first (merge-only, clean): `48c34822` merges main `7fdb629a`; this PR's own diff was unchanged by it (1,878 lines). Then tests (`089e8527`, failing-before), fix (`d197ea9c`), and `97c9005e` (one-time answer checked by billing type and price only).

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-345-1 (Opus) = B-345-2 (Sol): a cadence changed after the package was made never reached the server, and the helper remembered it | `toBackendUpdate` (src/api/packagesApi.ts) sends `billing_type`, `billing_interval`, `billing_interval_count` whenever `billingInterval` is set; one-time sends explicit nulls (backend B-629-4 clears the cadence, so recurring to free works in one PATCH). Stale TODO removed. `coachPackagesApi.update` checks the answer row when billing was sent: price and billing type must match, and for a recurring price also cadence and count; otherwise it fails closed with `PACKAGE_UPDATE_NOT_APPLIED` (specific copy, no Sentry report), so the helper does not remember the new input. `fromBackend` reads raw `interval` / `interval_count` (create and PATCH answers are raw rows: a yearly row no longer reads as monthly). Name-only edits send no billing fields and are not checked. | d197ea9c, 97c9005e | w1FixRound118.test.ts: exact PATCH bodies for monthly->one-time, one-time->monthly, paid->free; row kept old billing -> fails closed and intent unchanged; recurring cadence mismatch; yearly read-back |

Checked before the first step and after every await; once false it throws `PackageCreateStoppedError`: no request, no `onIntent`, no storage write. A sent intent stays on disk for the same account; a fresh intent written but never sent is removed again. | d197ea9c | w1FixRound118.test.ts: retired during write-ahead (no create, no callback, no leftover), re-sent create answering after sign-out, update answering after close, retired before start, live control |

Reference = server request id, else the X-Request-Id this app sent, else a fresh id (`diagnosticReference(supportReferenceOf(err))`); it is the Sentry `reference` tag, and the coach reads the same value (server id, or the short form of a client id). | d197ea9c | w1FixRound118.test.ts: local failure (fixed error, marker absent, shown ref = tagged ref), 500 with body text and a non-machine code, 418 with only the sent X-Request-Id |
| C-345-1 (Opus, copy truth on the money list) | Helper doc states the guarantee: per account on this device (sign-out wipes device storage); the form copy is narrowed in #346. | d197ea9c | - |
| C-345-2 (Opus) | W1 now carries its own tests for the helper, adapter and diagnostics. | 089e8527 | - |
| C-345-3 (Opus) | Tier header and Fix rounds table added to the PR body. | - | - |

Today's production backend (643817b3, coach backend #674/#676/#677 not deployed), capability checked in code:
- PATCH billing fields exist today (controller maps `billing_interval` -> `interval`), so the cadence fix works now.
- No `POST /coach/connect/status/refresh`: the 404/405 fallback to `GET /coach/connect/status` is now marked `refreshUnavailable`, so the panel (#346) does not say "Stripe did not answer just now".

- No `/v1/coach/money/charges`: the first-payment tick keeps the device-gate fallback, which can lag on a new device but never ticks without proof.

Failing-before (test commit `089e8527` without the fix): [CI lane 37219210136](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37219210136): 14 failed, 3 passed (the 3 are controls). The two cases added in `97c9005e`: "recurring cadence mismatch" fails before (no check existed); "one-time leftover cadence" is a control.

Money list self-check:
- Webhook order and redelivery: no webhook handling here; Connect state is read from the server after every Stripe visit, so a late or repeated event only changes what the next read shows.
- Concurrency: one Idempotency-Key per intent, written before send; a second tap is held by the caller's in-flight guard; a retired create sends nothing more; a re-send replays the same package. Two devices still use two keys (unchanged, server-side rule).
- Terminal states: 410 IDEMPOTENT_PACKAGE_REMOVED -> fresh create; archived or missing remembered package -> fresh create (#346); sign-out or account switch -> the create stops with no writes. Refund, dispute and cancel are not read by W1.
- List pagination and completeness: the setup reads are existence checks; `GET /v1/coach/packages` returns the coach's full list (no cursor); charges read uses `limit=1` for "any paid".
- Currency: USD only; prices compared in minor units (`amount_cents`) on the answer row; presentment = settlement (USD).
- Copy truth: nothing reports a cadence or price as saved until the server row shows it; stale and legacy status copy says what is known; guarantee copy narrowed (C-345-1).

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#345 @ 97c9005e644ebc13731d1477bfecc270a10552fd — VERDICT: APPROVE
A/B/C = 0/0/3

Agent 119, job AUD-OPUS-W12-119 (Opus lens), T4 (Connect onboarding, package money setup). This is a full audit of W1 at its exact head. No evidence is reused: Opus never approved #329 or this piece. Base is main; the branch is behind main cc4ceeed, but the newer main commits touch only account-deletion and support files, so nothing overlaps. Size: 2,573+/7- (2,580). The PR is grandfathered (opened 2026-10-03T20:49:31Z, on governance/PR_SIZE_GRANDFATHERED_2026-10-04.md) and is under its 3,000 ceiling.

Required checks at this head are green: [Typecheck, lint, test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220125291/job/111488593962), [Analyze js-ts](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220125300/job/111488594260), [Analyze actions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220125300/job/111488594181), [CodeQL](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/runs/111488664142).

Probe: [CI lane run 37229987672](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229987672) runs this head plus one spec (`src/lib/coachSetup/__tests__/audOpusW12_119_345.test.ts`, never merge). It uses the real `coachPackagesApi`, `createPackageOnce`, `describeError` and `toConnectView` over an axios double that applies a PATCH the way production `PackagesService.update` does (raw rows with `interval`). Result: 6/6 pass, made up of 3 verify cases and 3 observe cases (the observe cases pass because the C they record is real).

## B-345-1 — retired write-ahead cleanup erases the identity a replacement mount has sent

**Where:** `src/lib/coachSetup/packageCreateIntent.ts:361-368`, specifically unconditional `clearIntent(coachId, scope)` at `:367` after the awaited save notices retirement. [Exact helper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/97c9005e644ebc13731d1477bfecc270a10552fd/src/lib/coachSetup/packageCreateIntent.ts).

**Executed interleaving:** storage commits the first origin's write-ahead, but its completion promise is delayed; that origin unmounts; a replacement same-coach form hydrates the saved intent and sends its same key; the backend double commits one package but loses the response; only then the old save resolves. The retired origin assumes “never sent” and deletes the now-sent identity, so a subsequent hydrated retry emits a fresh UUID and the double contains two packages instead of one. This does not require out-of-order storage commits, account switching or sign-out. [Independent targeted proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229996097).

The test uses the actual helper/load path and a synthetic key-deduplicating backend; it proves durable identity deletion and a duplicate package, not a live Stripe/database transaction. [Executed probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229996097).

**Minimal fix rule:** retirement must not clear a persisted intent on the unsupported assumption that no other mount has sent it. Preserve the ambiguous saved key/body, or prove exclusive per-coach/per-scope ownership and coordinate retirement with replacement consumers before removal; an equality check on the key alone is insufficient because the replacement has legitimately sent that exact key. Keep sign-out wipe/drain rules intact.

**Verify:** the saved `audit119RetiredWriter.test.ts` cases must pass after the repair, including the lost-answer duplicate control; replay existing owner/unmount, write/read refusal, restart, cadence and diagnostic controls. The spec is retained at `ops/aud-119/AUD-SOL-W12-119/345-retired-writer.test.ts`. [Failing-before lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229996097).
